entries.title: China Open - WTA 1000
entries.hook: Beijing puts Rybakina, Sabalenka, Gauff and Andreeva on four separate paths through a deep draw.
entries.synopsis: The early rounds are about earning the marquee meetings, not assuming them. Gauff and Swiatek share a quarter, while Andreeva could run into Noskova and Sabalenka has Osaka in her section. Those are possible later matchups, not booked fixtures. With a 96-player singles field, the first weekend tests who can turn a favourable seed into a sustained run.

facts.statement: The singles draw contains 96 players.
The draw places Gauff and Swiatek in the same quarter.
Andreeva and Noskova are potential quarterfinal opponents, not a confirmed match.
Main-draw play began September 30 at the National Tennis Center in Beijing.

entries.title: Bahrain GP (Malaysia) - Qualifying
entries.hook: Sepang qualifying gives Antonelli a chance to interrupt Russell's momentum before Sunday.
entries.synopsis: Antonelli has acknowledged the challenge from his Mercedes team-mate. Saturday is the first direct contest for starting position at the Malaysian venue hosting this Bahrain round. Watch which driver finds a repeatable qualifying rhythm: a strong grid slot is valuable, but it is only the opening move before the 56-lap race.

facts.statement: The Bahrain round is hosted at Sepang International Circuit in Malaysia.
The event runs October 2-4, with the race on Sunday.
Antonelli says Russell has momentum and expects a tough challenge.
Sunday is scheduled for 56 laps of the 5.543-kilometre circuit.

entries.title: Bahrain GP (Malaysia) - Race
entries.hook: Sepang turns the Mercedes rivalry into a 56-lap examination of execution.
entries.synopsis: Antonelli and Russell arrive with the championship fight running through their own garage. Sunday asks a different question from qualifying: who can sustain their pace through an entire Grand Prix? This is the Bahrain event on Malaysian asphalt, so the venue is Sepang rather than Sakhir. The meaningful comparison is the two team-mates' race management, not a replay of Saturday's fastest lap.

facts.statement: Malaysia hosts the Bahrain Grand Prix at Sepang.
The race is scheduled over 56 laps.
The Grand Prix takes place on October 4.
Antonelli identifies Russell as a tough challenge carrying momentum.

entries.title: MotoGP Japanese Grand Prix
entries.hook: Martin and Marquez reach Motegi with only 12 points between them entering the weekend.
entries.synopsis: The title fight is not confined to the leading pair: Bezzecchi starts the Japan weekend 42 points off the lead, and Acosta is another rider to watch in the closing stretch. Sunday provides the longer test after Saturday's Sprint. With five Grands Prix packed into six weeks, protecting a result matters almost as much as finding outright speed.

facts.statement: Martin enters Japan 12 points ahead of Marc Marquez.
Bezzecchi is 42 points behind Martin entering the weekend.
The flyaway stretch includes five Grands Prix in six weeks.
The Japanese Grand Prix is at Mobility Resort Motegi.
The Saturday Sprint is scheduled for 12 laps before Sunday's Grand Prix.

entries.title: Roosters v Broncos
entries.hook: The unbeaten Roosters face the one opponent who can turn their perfect season into unfinished business.
entries.synopsis: Brisbane are chasing consecutive premierships; Sydney are trying to reverse last year's decider against the same side. That gives this rematch a clear contrast: the Roosters' season-long consistency against the Broncos' experience of finishing this job. Belinda Sharpe takes charge of her fifth grand final, with the premiership settled in one match.

facts.statement: Roosters and Broncos meet in a second consecutive NRLW Grand Final.
The Roosters enter undefeated.
The Broncos are pursuing back-to-back premierships.
Belinda Sharpe is appointed to her fifth grand final.

entries.title: Roosters v Knights
entries.hook: Tedesco and Ponga give this decider two very different routes to a match-winning moment.
entries.synopsis: Both fullbacks are named in the official grand-final teams, putting their influence at the centre of the Roosters-Knights contest. Sydney are seeking their first premiership in seven years; Newcastle have reached the last step of their revival. Watch the space each side creates for its fullback rather than treating this as a contest of reputations. There is no next round to recover in.

facts.statement: James Tedesco and Kalyn Ponga are named as the respective starting fullbacks.
The Roosters seek their first premiership in seven years.
Roosters v Knights is scheduled October 4 at 7.30pm AEDT at Accor Stadium.
Adam Gee is appointed to the NRL Grand Final.
